user.title: Connect to your Hisense TV
user.description: Connects directly to the TV's own MQTT broker - no separate Mosquitto bridge needed. Upload the CA and client certificate files for your TV below (the same ones previously used for a Mosquitto bridge config). When reconfiguring, leave a certificate field empty to keep the file already on file.

data.name: Name
data.tls_ca_cert_upload: CA certificate (leave empty if not required)
data.tls_client_cert_upload: Client certificate (leave empty if not required)
data.tls_client_key_upload: Client key (leave empty if not required)

auth.title: Enter the PIN
auth.description: Enter the PIN code shown on the TV screen.

progress.progress_action: Waiting for the TV to respond…

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV's broker. Check the IP address, port, and certificate files.
